messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Economic conditions and indicators in Germany during the 2010s and 2020s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Destatis GENESIS Online database Germany economic indicators GDP inflation employment
Eurostat database Germany GDP unemployment inflation data
World Bank Germany country indicators data GDP inflation 2010 2024
Bundesbank time series database German economic indicators
